purpose: Create a source-native, stable-ID activity cohort for future targeted trend tracking; not revenue or demand proof.

selection.github: Up to 6 distinct GitHub issue/discussion records with an actual integer nonnegative comments/reply count and exact raw locator, sorted by canonical source_id as text ascending.
selection.hn: Up to 6 distinct HN story records with actual integer nonnegative num_comments and exact raw locator, sorted by canonical source_id as text ascending. HN comment records without a reply counter are retained as discovery data but excluded from the measured cohort.
selection.deduplication: Within source by stable source_id. Multiple search hits do not create independent observations.
selection.tie_break: Earliest actual retrieval timestamp then lexicographically smallest raw path.
selection.missing: Never fill quota with invented cases; record fewer eligible records and report GAP.

metric.name: source_native_thread_reply_count
metric.github_field: comments for issue REST/search records; discussion reply count only if explicitly present in raw data
metric.comparability: Compare each record only to its own later value from the same endpoint/field. Do not aggregate GitHub and HN counter levels or interpret them as revenue/demand.
metric.secondary: HN points may be stored separately, never substituted for missing reply count.

sampling.discovery: Read final accepted WS1/WS2 output once. Preserve each WS query plan and current response hashes as protocol references.
sampling.timing_caveat: Workstreams are parallel; this protocol was frozen before WS3 inspected current live records, but not guaranteed before other scouts began acquisition. Current T0 therefore remains provisional discovery, not a fully predeclared qualifying trend series.
sampling.future_protocol: Before any new qualifying T0, freeze the resulting stable cohort IDs and endpoint/query/retrieval method; obtain human approval, then measure T0 and same records at T+7/T+14.
sampling.missingness: Record unavailable/deleted/rate-limited fields as null plus reason; no zero imputation, no replacement record, no cohort swapping.
sampling.updates: Record source-created/source-updated/retrieved times separately. Current query ranking never defines growth.

evidence_gate.reason: No same-cohort T+7/T+14 observation exists. Current discovery T0 is provisional and not sufficient for EMERGING or Top5.

missing_dependency.name: 12 real cases from Cổng 2
missing_dependency.replacement_claim: None. New discovery cohort is not represented as the missing Cổng 2 dataset.
